podcast.title: Songwriter for FAME Studios
podcast.body: George Jackson was an R&B songwriter who penned material for the legendary FAME Studios in Muscle Shoals, Alabama. "George was an R&B guy and he wrote for the legendary famed studios in Muscle Shoals Alabama."

podcast.title: Wrote "One Bad Apple" with Jackson 5 in Mind
podcast.body: Jackson wrote "One Bad Apple" specifically with The Jackson Five in mind, though the song was ultimately recorded by The Osmonds at FAME Studios, becoming a number one hit. "In fact the songwriter George Jackson did have the Jackson 5 in mind when he wrote it."
